samsung - galaxy watch ultra2 titanium s.description: Whether you’re exploring the outdoors, chasing a new personal record or simply working to build healthier habits, Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is our most advanced smartwatch yet built to be your companion through it all. You can now run through challenging trails confidently with the all new Trail Running feature that gives guidance around path, pace, elevation and more. Running on a sunny day? The 5,000 nit display keeps your screen ultra bright and visible. Planning on a recreational dive? Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is EN13319 certified for diving, with real time guidance through the Mares dive computer app. Beyond the outdoors, Watch Ultra2 can be your personal coach with Fitness Index, which delivers guided training programs tailored to you. And while you’re working on your goals, Heart Health Score and Vitals help you keep tabs on your health and deliver personalized guidance so you can build toward a healthier version of yourself. With Watch Ultra2 you can also move lighter without losing connection. Cellular connectivity keeps calls, texts, emails and important updates within reach, even when your phone stays behind. And as your Watch connects to your Galaxy ecosystem, you can Tap to Pay, take your playlists with you on the Watch, control your camera, take calls from your wrist and more effortlessly. Galaxy Watch Ultra2 combines rugged performance with intelligent guidance, helping you go further and do more with confidence.
